series.title: The Wolf King's Substitute Bride
series.note: SEASON PLAN, broken before writing (docs/DRAMA.md). Supernatural romance, the top genre on the short-drama apps: substitute bride, contract marriage, a cursed alpha, a hidden bloodline, public face-slaps. CAST: Mira Hale, 24, works unpaid in her stepmother's flower shop in the town of Thornfield. Vivian Hale, her stepmother. Celeste Hale, her beautiful, cruel stepsister. Kael Blackthorn, king of the Blackthorn wolves, cursed for a hundred years to lose himself to his wolf every full moon. Rowan, his second-in-command and best friend, father of a small son, Pip. Grandmother Ysolde, the pack's old seer. Lucian Blackthorn, Kael's charming cousin, next in line for the throne. RULES OF THE MAGIC: a wolf's eyes turn gold when it recognises its true mate; silver wounds wolves; the curse was cast by a moon witch and only her line can lift it. SEASON QUESTION: who is Mira really, and can the curse be broken before Lucian takes the throne? PROMISES: P1 the silver crescent birthmark on Mira's wrist (planted ep1, paid ep5); P2 white roses bloom wherever Mira's tears fall (planted ep1, paid ep5 and ep10); P3 Ysolde's prophecy 'the bride who was not chosen' (planted ep2, paid ep6 and ep10); P4 Lucian's ring with a black stone (planted ep3, paid ep8 and ep10); P5 the locked tower room (planted ep4, paid ep5 and ep7). BIG TWIST at ep5 (where the apps put the paywall).

episodes.title: The Wrong Bride
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: The Blackthorn pack has paid the Hale family a fortune for Celeste's hand in a marriage contract with their reclusive king. On the wedding morning Celeste refuses to 'marry a monster', and Vivian forces Mira into the dress and the veil instead, telling her she owes them for every meal she has eaten. In the stone chapel of Blackthorn Castle, Kael lifts the veil, and the pack gasps. PLANT P1: Mira hides the silver crescent birthmark on her wrist under a lace glove, as she always has. PLANT P2: one tear falls on the chapel floor, and nobody notices the white rose that opens there. SATISFACTION: when Celeste, watching from the front row, sneers 'She's just the flower girl', Kael says, 'Then she's the only one here who came.' ENDS ON: Kael leans close, breathes in, and his eyes turn gold. 'You're not the woman I was promised,' he says quietly. 'But you're the one my wolf just chose.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: One Year, One Contract
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Kael offers Mira a deal across a long table in his study: one year as his queen in name only, then her freedom and enough money to open her own flower shop. She signs, on one condition of her own: nobody in this castle ever calls her 'the flower girl' again. The pack's nobles sneer at the substitute bride; Lucian is the only one who is kind to her, with a little too much charm. Celeste hears how rich the Blackthorns really are and starts to regret refusing. PLANT P3: old Grandmother Ysolde takes Mira's hand at dinner and whispers, 'The bride who was not chosen.' SATISFACTION: a noblewoman mocks Mira's plain manners; Mira names every flower in the banquet garlands and which ones are poisonous to wolves, and the noblewoman quietly moves her plate. ENDS ON: the first full moon. Kael comes to her door, his hands shaking. 'Lock it,' he says. 'Whatever you hear tonight, don't open it.' The howling starts.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Full Moon
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: In the night Mira hears a child crying in the courtyard: Rowan's small son Pip, who has wandered out of bed. She unlocks the door to bring him in, and comes face to face with a huge black wolf: Kael, lost to the curse. Instead of running, she puts herself between the wolf and the boy and speaks to him gently. The wolf lies down at her feet; for the first time in a hundred years, the curse loosens its grip on a Blackthorn king. REVERSAL: Rowan, arriving with a silver spear, sees his king calm and his son safe. PLANT P4: Lucian watches from a balcony, turning a ring with a black stone on his finger, and he is not smiling. SATISFACTION: at breakfast Rowan bows to Mira in front of the whole pack. ENDS ON: a carriage arrives at the castle gates. Celeste steps out, 'invited as a guest by Lord Lucian', and she is wearing Mira's late mother's silver necklace.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Stepsister's Trap
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Celeste plays the sweet sister in public and, in private, tells Mira she will take everything back. When the queen's ruby brooch goes missing, it is found in Mira's flower basket, and the pack nobles call for a trial before the king. REVERSAL: little Pip, the boy Mira saved, tells the court he saw 'the pretty lady with the silver necklace' put it there. SATISFACTION: Celeste is made to apologise on her knees before the pack, and Kael gives Mira back her mother's necklace with his own hands. PLANT P5: that night Grandmother Ysolde warns Mira never to open the locked room at the top of the old east tower. ENDS ON: Mira finds a heavy iron key in her flower basket, tied with a black ribbon. Somebody wants her to open the tower.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Witch's Portrait
episodes.covers: BIG TWIST (paywall point). WHAT HAPPENS: Mira climbs the east tower (P5) and unlocks the room. Inside, dust, dead roses, and a life-size portrait of the moon witch who cursed the pack a hundred years ago. The witch has Mira's face, and on her wrist is the same silver crescent mark (P1 paid off). Mira cries, and white roses push up through the stone floor around her feet (P2 paid off): magic she has hidden all her life. REVERSAL: the story she was told, that her real mother was a florist who died young, was a lie Vivian kept to hide her. ENDS ON: footsteps on the stairs. Kael stands in the doorway, sees the portrait, sees the mark on her bare wrist, and his eyes go cold. 'You're one of them.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Enemy's Blood
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: The pack learns the substitute bride is the witch's heir, and the nobles demand her banishment or her death. Kael, torn, confines her to her rooms 'for her own safety' and posts guards, which she refuses to accept, and she tells him so. Grandmother Ysolde finally speaks the whole prophecy (P3): the curse was cast because a Blackthorn lord murdered the witch's daughter, and only the witch's heir, the bride who was not chosen, can lift it. REVERSAL: Lucian, ever helpful, announces he has found the cure in the old books: the heir's blood on the altar at the next full moon. SATISFACTION: Mira faces the nobles alone, without Kael, and asks which of them would like to tell the room what their great-grandfathers did to a fifteen-year-old girl. Nobody answers. ENDS ON: the council votes for the blood ritual. Every eye turns to Kael. He says nothing.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: What the Diary Said
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Rowan, who owes Mira his son, helps her slip out of the castle at night. She goes back up the tower (P5) and finds, behind the portrait, the witch's diary. The curse does not need blood: it breaks when the truth of the old crime is spoken aloud before the whole pack, and love is given freely by the heir. REVERSAL: Kael finds her there and he did not come to stop her. He says he was silent at the council because he was buying time to get her away, and he would have burned the altar before letting anyone touch her. SATISFACTION: the first kiss, among the dead roses, which bloom white all around them. ENDS ON: they run back to the castle to tell Ysolde, and find the old seer collapsed on the floor of her room, a silver cup rolling from her hand. She grips Mira's arm and whispers one word: 'Ring.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Black Ring
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Mira's roses draw the poison out of Ysolde, and the seer lives. The cup was poisoned with nightshade from the castle garden, and Mira, who knows every flower, proves it came from Lucian's private greenhouse. REVERSAL: Lucian's black ring (P4) is a hex-stone, carved from the witch's own stolen spellbook: for years he has been feeding the curse to keep Kael weak and the throne within reach. Celeste realises he only used her to get close to Mira. SATISFACTION: Celeste, for once in her life, tells the truth, in front of the pack: Lucian gave her the brooch and the key. ENDS ON: the night of the Moon Festival. In the crowd, Lucian's hand closes over Mira's mouth. 'If the witch's heir dies under the full moon,' he whispers, 'the curse becomes mine to command.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Blood Moon
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Lucian drags Mira to the ruined chapel on the cliffs, where the witch's daughter died. Kael and Rowan chase them through the forest as the moon rises red. Mira's power wakes fully: thorned roses burst from the ground and hold Lucian's wolves back. REVERSAL: under the full moon Kael shifts, and for the first time he stays himself inside the wolf, because Mira is near. SATISFACTION: the pack, who voted to kill her, arrives and stands behind Mira. ENDS ON: Lucian drives a silver blade into Kael's side. The great wolf falls at Mira's feet, and the red moon reaches the top of the sky.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Bride Who Was Not Chosen
episodes.covers: FINALE, LANDS: With Kael bleeding in her arms, Mira stands before the whole pack and speaks the truth of the old crime aloud: the Blackthorn lord, the witch's daughter, the century of lies (P3 paid off). Then she tells Kael, in front of everyone, that she chooses him, contract or no contract. Her tears fall on him and white roses cover the chapel (P2 paid off). The curse breaks with a sound like ice cracking on a lake; Lucian's black ring shatters on his finger (P4 paid off), and without its power he is just a man, surrounded by the pack he betrayed, who take him away to answer for it. Kael's wound closes. Back at the castle he tears the one-year contract in half and asks her properly, on one knee, in the chapel where she wore Celeste's veil. LAST IMAGE: white roses climbing the castle walls, and in the town below, a little flower shop with a new sign: 'Mira's'.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

series.title: The Alien Who Rented My Attic
series.note: SEASON PLAN, broken before writing. Joyful sci-fi romance with comedy and real stakes: fish out of water, hidden identity, a ticking clock, a family secret from the stars. CAST: Zoe Park, 27, runs her late grandmother's struggling bakery in the seaside town of Harbor Bay. Orion, a prince from the planet Velara, stranded on Earth and pretending to be 'Ryan from Ohio'. Gran (Park Ji-ah), Zoe's late grandmother, heard through her recipe notebook and a recorded message. Tess Moreno, Zoe's best friend and the town's only deputy. Mayor Dex Calloway, the charming new mayor, secretly Vrell, a bounty hunter sent by Orion's usurping uncle. Agent Ray Graves, a grey-suited government man. RULES: Velaran freckles glow when they lie; Velarans cannot eat Earth food without a special tea; Orion's wrist shows a countdown to when Velara's gateway closes for a generation; the ship's core is a blue stone that hums near Velaran blood. SEASON QUESTION: can Orion get home, and does he even want to? PROMISES: P1 Gran's blue 'lucky stone' by the till (planted ep1, paid ep5); P2 Gran's recipe notebook with star-shaped doodles in the margins (planted ep2, paid ep7); P3 Orion's freckles glow when he lies (planted ep1, paid ep4 and ep9); P4 Mayor Calloway never eats or drinks in public (planted ep3, paid ep6); P5 the countdown on Orion's wrist (planted ep2, paid ep10); P6 Zoe has never been ill in her life and hears a hum near the stone (planted ep1, paid ep8). BIG TWIST at ep5.

episodes.title: The Man Who Fell on My Roof
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: During a storm something crashes into the rooftop garden above Zoe Park's bakery. She climbs up with a rolling pin and finds a very tall, very confused man wrapped in her tablecloth, who says his name is 'Ryan, from Ohio', and asks what the water falling from the sky is for. The bakery is three months from eviction and Zoe has bigger problems, but she lets him sleep in the attic. PLANT P3: when he says 'Ohio', the freckles across his nose glow faintly blue. PLANT P1 and P6: Gran's blue lucky stone by the till hums when he walks past it, and Zoe, who has never had so much as a cold, feels the hum in her teeth. SATISFACTION: he fixes her broken oven in ten seconds by touching it. ENDS ON: the late news reports a meteor strike in Harbor Bay with 'no debris found'. Ryan watches it, and his eyes go silver. 'They've found the crash,' he says. 'Which means they'll find me.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Thirty Days
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Ryan offers to pay rent with a gold bar, which solves the eviction and creates a lot of new questions. He works the counter in an apron, terrifies customers by eating a whole lemon, and turns out to be brilliant at icing. PLANT P5: Zoe sees thirty tiny lights on the inside of his wrist; one goes out at midnight. PLANT P2: he spends an hour turning the pages of Gran's old recipe notebook, staring at the little star doodles in the margins. SATISFACTION: the rival bakery owner who has been mocking Zoe for years comes in to gloat, tastes Ryan's lemon tart, and buys twelve. ENDS ON: a man in a grey suit walks in and shows a badge: Agent Ray Graves, asking about 'unusual new arrivals'. Ryan is standing right behind the counter, covered in flour.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Mayor's Smile
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Graves leaves with a cinnamon bun and a suspicious look. At the town's autumn fair, the handsome new mayor, Dex Calloway, flirts with Zoe and offers to buy the bakery at three times its value. Ryan is very jealous and very bad at hiding it. PLANT P4: the mayor praises Zoe's pie extravagantly but never takes a bite, and never touches his drink. SATISFACTION: in the fair's pie contest Zoe beats the rival baker again, and the crowd cheers her. ENDS ON: in the evening light, Ryan notices the mayor's shadow moves a second after he does. 'He isn't human either,' he tells Zoe. 'He's a hunter. And he's here for me.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Glowing Lies
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Zoe demands the truth, and when he tries one more lie his freckles glow like a night light (P3 paid off). So he tells her: his name is Orion, prince of Velara; his uncle seized the throne and sent a hunter after him; his ship crashed and lost its core, a blue stone; and in thirty days Velara's gateway closes for a generation, and his people will lose their rightful king. Zoe laughs, then faints, then makes tea. REVERSAL: the gruff Tess, sworn to protect the town, decides she believes him before Zoe does. SATISFACTION: Zoe agrees to help, and their first real conversation turns into their first almost-kiss. ENDS ON: Orion's wrist flickers: twenty-two lights become twelve at once. 'Somebody has found the wreck,' he says. 'And they're draining it.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Gran's Lucky Stone
episodes.covers: BIG TWIST (paywall point). WHAT HAPPENS: They search the woods for the core and find only the burned shell of the ship. Back at the bakery, defeated, Zoe picks up Gran's blue lucky stone, and it lights up in her hand, humming (P1 and P6 paid off). It is a ship's core, and it has been sitting by the till for forty years. REVERSAL: Orion's ship is not the first from Velara to crash in Harbor Bay. ENDS ON: inside the light, a recording plays: a young woman in an old-fashioned flight suit speaks in Orion's language, then turns to the camera and speaks in English. It is Gran, aged twenty. 'Zoe, if you are hearing this, someone from home has finally come for you.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Hunter Unmasked
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Gran's message explains: she was a royal navigator from Velara who crash-landed in 1985, fell in love with a fisherman and chose to stay, hiding her stone in plain sight. Zoe needs to show the town who the mayor really is. At the council meeting she serves him his 'favourite pie' in front of everyone (P4 paid off). SATISFACTION: he cannot eat it, the town watches him try, and his human face flickers. REVERSAL: Vrell runs, but takes Tess as he goes. ENDS ON: a message on the bakery's old answering machine, in the mayor's smooth voice: 'The stone, at the lighthouse, midnight. Or your deputy goes home with me.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Recipe Code
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Gran's notebook (P2 paid off): the star doodles are navigation charts, and one recipe, 'Moon Glass Candy', is a trick she wrote for exactly this: sugar glass that hums like a core when it is still warm. Zoe and Orion bake a fake core in the middle of the night, arguing about oven temperatures and laughing. REVERSAL: Agent Graves turns up and is not an enemy: he was Gran's friend for forty years and kept her secret from his own agency. SATISFACTION: at the lighthouse the swap works, Tess is freed, and Tess punches the hunter. ENDS ON: Vrell bites into the sugar core, crunches it, and laughs. 'Clever. But I never came for the stone. I came for the navigator's blood.' He looks straight at Zoe.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Half of Me
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Zoe learns why she has never been ill and why the stone hums for her (P6 paid off): she is half Velaran, Gran's granddaughter, and only a navigator's heir can open the gateway. The usurping uncle wants her to open it for his army. Orion says he will stay on Earth forever so she is never in danger. REVERSAL: Zoe refuses to let him give up his people for her. SATISFACTION: the real kiss, on the roof where he fell, under the stars Gran crossed. ENDS ON: every light on Orion's wrist goes out but one. Vrell has used the wreck to force the gateway: it opens tomorrow at midnight, from the other side.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Last Day
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: The whole of Harbor Bay, who have finally worked out that the bakery's tall new baker is not from Ohio, turn up to help: the rival baker, the fishermen, the knitting club, Agent Graves. Orion is getting weaker without Velara's light; when he tells Zoe 'I'm fine', his freckles glow (P3 paid off) and she makes him rest. SATISFACTION: the town turns the bakery into a fortress, mostly with flour and stubbornness, and it is wonderful. ENDS ON: at midnight Zoe puts her hand on Gran's stone and the gateway tears open above the harbour, and the first one through it is Vrell.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Home Is Where the Pie Is
episodes.covers: FINALE, LANDS: Zoe uses the trick in the last page of Gran's notebook: a navigator can turn a gateway around. She reverses it, and Vrell is pulled back through to face Velara's court, where the usurper is already falling to the loyal guard. Orion's countdown (P5 paid off) resets with a new rule: the stone, in the hands of a navigator's heir, can open the gateway once every year. He can be king at home and come back every autumn, or bring his people's ambassador to Harbor Bay. He chooses both, and asks Zoe to be the navigator. LAST IMAGE: a new sign over the bakery, 'Gran's: Out of This World', the blue stone back by the till, and a very tall man standing in the rain on purpose, finally liking it.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map
